primary_dataset: AVeriTeC official claim files and static knowledge store

development_split_policy.reporting_before_hidden_test: dev only; do not call these final test results

retrieval_judgment_note: Until exact passage-level annotations are aligned with the downloaded knowledge store, source-URL qrels are an annotated-source-URL proxy and must be reported as such.
